summary: Episode ep_018 (EP18) covers a night fire in a cottage: Juliana wakes to flames, Alexander breaks in and leads her out through collapsing corridors, she retrieves her mother's ledger, and they escape through a parlor window to the front yard, where Alexander vows to act against those responsible. Uncertainty: source warnings state that scenes sc_002, sc_003 and sc_005 have incomplete coverage with gaps unavailable, so beats spanning those scenes may omit events. The cause of the fire is not shown on screen; the claim that someone wanted them out (EP18:E74) is a character's assertion, not a confirmed fact. Metadata was not used as evidence, and no dialogue, event references or timestamps were invented.

characters.name: Juliana
characters.role: Cottage occupant who wakes to the fire, protects her mother's ledger, and is rescued by Alexander

characters.name: Alexander
characters.role: Protector who breaks in to rescue Juliana, leads the escape, and vows vengeance against those he believes responsible

beats.description: Flames and smoke appear under the bedroom door and Juliana wakes coughing from the smoke.
Juliana rises in panic, calls for Alexander, and sits huddled and sobbing as the fire closes in on the bedroom.
Alexander kicks open the door, crosses the burning room, lifts Juliana to her feet, and tells her the cause is fire.
The main exit is sealed by flames and falling beams, so Alexander leads Juliana through another route.
Juliana refuses to leave the ledger behind, breaks free from Alexander, and seizes the burning book as a beam collapses.
A rafter splits above Juliana, Alexander tackles her clear of a falling beam, and he shields her while reassuring her.
Walls collapse behind them, Alexander carries Juliana through the parlor window, and they reach the dark grass outside.
Villagers arrive as the cottage burns; Juliana grieves her lost home and possessions, Alexander comforts her, and Juliana says they have nowhere to go.
Alexander's face hardens with fury as he vows not to let anything else be taken, and the episode closes on his resolve toward vengeance.

revelations.claim: Alexander says someone wanted them out of the cottage, suggesting the fire was deliberate; this is an unverified assertion on screen.
